data.description: Represents a registered system user with authentication credentials and role-based access. *(analyzed in 2 chunks)*
data.name: User

properties.description: Unique email address used for login
properties.name: email

properties.description: Role in the system: owner or staff
properties.name: role

and: Role defaults to staff
Status defaults to active

and: Cannot log in when inactive
scenarios.name: Deactivate user

validations: Email must be unique
Role must be 'owner' or 'staff'
Status must be 'active' or 'inactive'

data.description: Represents an authenticated user session for stateless authentication. *(analyzed in 2 chunks)*

and: Session is deleted via cascade when user is deleted
scenarios.name: Expire session
scenarios.then: Session is removed from database

validations: User must exist
Expires at must be in the future
Session is deleted when user is deleted (cascade)

data.description: Represents a raw material or ingredient used in product manufacturing with pricing per unit. *(analyzed in 2 chunks)*
data.name: RawMaterial

properties.description: Base unit of measurement: ml, l, cl, gr, kg, or pcs
properties.name: base_unit

properties.description: Price per base unit in smallest currency unit
properties.name: price_per_base_unit

scenarios.name: Soft delete material

properties.description: Selling price to outlet in smallest currency unit
properties.name: price_to_outlet

and: HPP override takes precedence when present
scenarios.name: Use override cost
scenarios.then: HPP override is used instead of calculated recipe cost for pricing decisions

Price to outlet must be >= 0
HPP override if present must be >= 0
Status must be 'active' or 'inactive'

data.description: Represents a bill of materials line item linking a product to its raw material components. *(analyzed in 2 chunks)*
data.name: ProductRecipe

properties.description: Unit for quantity: ml, l, cl, gr, kg, or pcs
properties.name: unit

relationships.description: Recipe belongs to exactly one product
Recipe references exactly one raw material

and: Unique constraint prevents duplicate material per product
scenarios.name: Add recipe component
scenarios.then: Recipe line is created linking product to material with positive quantity

and: Cascade delete removes all recipes when product deleted
scenarios.name: Clean up recipes
scenarios.then: All associated product recipes are removed

and: Restrict prevents material deletion if used in recipes
scenarios.given: Material is referenced in active recipe
scenarios.name: Protect referenced material
scenarios.then: Material deletion is blocked with restrict constraint

validations: Quantity must be > 0
Unit must be one of: ml, l, cl, gr, kg, pcs
Product and raw material combination must be unique
Product deletion cascades to recipes

data.description: Represents a retail outlet or store location with geographic coordinates. *(analyzed in 2 chunks)*
data.name: Outlet

properties.description: S3 or R2 key for outlet photo
properties.name: photo_key

relationships.description: Outlet can have multiple consignment cycles

and: Status defaults to active
scenarios.given: Valid outlet data with GPS coordinates
scenarios.name: Create outlet
scenarios.then: Outlet is persisted with geographic index for spatial queries

and: Geo index enables nearby outlet queries
scenarios.name: Query by location
scenarios.then: Outlets within geographic bounds are returned efficiently

validations: Latitude must be between -90 and 90
Longitude must be between -180 and 180
Status must be 'active' or 'inactive'
Name is required

data.description: Represents a consignment inventory cycle where products are dropped at an outlet and later picked up with sales/returns reconciliation. *(analyzed in 2 chunks)*
data.name: ConsignmentCycle

properties.description: Price to outlet at time of drop (snapshot)
properties.name: price_snapshot

properties.description: When cycle was closed and picked up
properties.name: picked_up_at

properties.description: Cycle status: open, closed, or voided
properties.name: status

properties.description: Reference to visit submission that created/updated cycle
properties.name: visit_submission_id

relationships.description: Cycle belongs to exactly one outlet
Cycle contains exactly one product type
Cycle may be linked to a visit submission

and: HPP and price are snapshotted at drop time
All quantities default to 0 except qty_dropped
scenarios.name: Drop consignment
scenarios.then: Open cycle is created with product, outlet, quantities, and snapshot pricing

and: Index on outlet + open status enables quick lookup
scenarios.name: Find open cycles
scenarios.then: Open cycles for outlet not yet picked up are returned

and: Picked up at marks cycle closure
scenarios.given: Cycle is open with sales and returns recorded
scenarios.name: Pick up consignment
scenarios.then: Cycle status changes to closed, picked_up_at is set, final reconciliation calculated

and: Voided status cancels the cycle
scenarios.name: Void cycle
scenarios.then: Cycle status changes to voided, no financial impact recorded

validations: HPP snapshot must be >= 0
Price snapshot must be >= 0
Quantity dropped must be > 0
Quantity sold must be >= 0
Quantity returned good must be >= 0
Quantity returned damaged must be >= 0
Amount collected must be >= 0
Outlet deletion restricted if open cycles exist
Product deletion restricted if referenced in cycles
qty_sold + qty_return_good + qty_return_damaged <= qty_dropped when closed

data.description: Represents a submitted visit record by a user to an outlet, including geolocation data, geofence validation, and optional override capabilities. *(analyzed in 2 chunks)*
data.name: VisitSubmission

properties.description: Calculated distance from client to outlet in meters
properties.name: distance_m

properties.description: Allowed radius for geofence validation in meters
properties.name: geofence_radius_m

properties.description: Unique idempotency key for duplicate prevention
properties.name: idempotency_key

properties.description: Optional notes attached to the visit
properties.name: notes

properties.description: Current lifecycle status of the submission
properties.name: status

properties.description: Timestamp when the submission was voided
properties.name: voided_at

relationships.description: Visit submission is associated with a specific outlet
Visit submission is created by a user
Visit submission may be voided by a user

and: distance_m is calculated from client coordinates to outlet coordinates
geofence_override is false by default
scenarios.given: A user is within valid range of an outlet or provides override reason
scenarios.name: Submit valid visit
scenarios.then: VisitSubmission is created with status 'committed' and idempotency_key set
scenarios.when: visit submission is received with valid outlet_id, user_id, and location data

and: voided_at is set to current timestamp
voided_by references the user performing the action
scenarios.name: Void existing visit
scenarios.then: VisitSubmission status changes to 'voided'
scenarios.when: authorized user submits void request with reason

and: geofence_override_reason must be provided when override is true
scenarios.given: User is outside geofence_radius_m from outlet
scenarios.name: Geofence override submission
scenarios.then: VisitSubmission is accepted with geofence_override true and reason recorded
scenarios.when: user submits visit with geofence_override set to true and provides override reason

validations: distance_m must be greater than or equal to 0
geofence_radius_m must be greater than 0
status must be either 'committed' or 'voided'
geofence_override_reason is required when geofence_override is true
voided_at, voided_by, and void_reason are required when status is 'voided'
idempotency_key must be unique across all submissions
outlet_id must reference an existing Outlet
user_id must reference an existing User
voided_by must reference an existing User when provided

data.description: Represents the current navigation state within the single-page application, mapping URL paths to logical route names with associated parameters.

data.description: Represents a password credential with PBKDF2 hashing for secure storage and verification.

scenarios.given: A plaintext password of at least 6 characters
scenarios.name: Hash password
scenarios.then: A deterministic hash string is returned using PBKDF2-SHA-256 with 100,000 iterations

scenarios.then: Returns true if password matches hash, false otherwise

scenarios.given: A plaintext password with fewer than 6 characters
scenarios.name: Reject short password
scenarios.then: ValidationError is thrown with minimum length message
